title: nan
authors: Briggs M.M.; Castano L.M.; Morgan E.
key_contribution: Presents an AI-based pattern matching feature-augmented terrain referenced navigation algorithm for sUAS using radial-scan LiDAR point clouds in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
